Staff Platform Engineer — Contoso Cloud

About the role
You will lead reliability work across our multi-region Kubernetes platform and mentor engineers on incident response.

Qualifications
- 7+ years building distributed systems
- Deep experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Linux
- Strong Go or Rust
- Working knowledge of Terraform and AWS
- Experience with Kafka and Redis preferred

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
- Comfortable on-call for production services

Compensation and benefits
Competitive salary, equity, and health coverage.

We celebrate diversity and are an equal opportunity employer. Reasonable accommodation is available for applicants with disabilities.
